<L>1.002<pc>0001-1<k1>aH<k2>aH<e>1
{#a#} + .{@{#aH#}@}¦ [{#avati, atati sAtatyena tizWatIti vA#}; {#av-at- vA, qa#} <ls>Tv.</ls>]
∙²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu, the first of the three sounds constituting the sacred
 syllable {#om#}; {#akAro vizRuruddizwa ukArastu maheSvaraH . makArastu smfto#}
 {#brahmA praRavastu trayAtmakaH ..#} For more explanations of the three
 syllables {#a, u, m#} see {#om#}.
∙²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva, Brahmā, Vāyu, or Vaiśvānara. −[{#aH kfzRaH SaMkaro#}
 {#brahmA SakraH somo'nilo'nalaH . sUryaH prARo yamaH kAlo vasantaH praRavaH#}
 {#suKI ..#} <ab>Enm.</ab> {#aH syAd brahmaRi vizRvISakUrmARaNkaraRezu ca . gOrave'ntaHpure#}
 {#hetO BUzaRe'NGrAvumejyayoH ..#} <ls>Nm.</ls> {#aH SiKAyAM sidDamantre pragrAhe'rke#}
 {#raTArvaRi . cakre kukkuwamUrDnIndubimbe brahmeSavizRuzu ..#} <ab>ibid.</ab> Thus
 {#aH#} means Kṛṣṇa, Śiva, Brahmā, Indra, Soma, Vāyu, Agni, the
 Sun, the life-breath, Yama, Kāla, Vasanta, Praṇava, a happy man, a tortoise,
 a courtyard, a battle, greatness, a female apartment in a palace, an object
 or a cause, an ornament, a foot, Umā, sacrifice, a flame, a particularly
 efficacious mantra, reins, the horse of a chariot, a wheel, the head of
 a cock, the disc of the moon]; 
<LEND>
<L>1.004<pc>0001-1<k1>a<k2>a<e>1
{#a#}¦ {%<lex>ind.</lex>%}
∙²1 A prefix corresponding to <lang>Latin</lang> {%in%}, <lang>Eng.</lang> {%in%} or {%un%}, <lang>Gr.</lang>
 {%a%} or {%an%}, and joined to nouns, adjectives, indeclinables (or rarely
 even to verbs) as a substitute for the negative particle {#naY#}, and
 changed to {#an#} before vowels (except in the word {#a-fRin#}). The
 senses of {#na#} usually enumerated are six:−
∙³({%a%}) {#sAdfSya#} ‘likeness’ or ‘resemblance’; {#abrAhmaRaH#} one like
 a Brāhmaṇa (wearing the sacred thread <ab>&c.</ab>), but not a Brāhmaṇa; a
 Kṣatriya, or a Vaiśya; {#anikzuH#} a reed appearing like {#ikzu#}, but
 not a true {#ikzu#}.
∙³({%b%}) {#aBAva#} ‘absence’, ‘negation’, ‘want’, ‘privation’; {#ajYAnam#}
 absence of knowledge, ignorance; {#akroDaH, anaNgaH, akaRwakaH, aGawaH#} <ab>&c.</ab>
∙³({%c%}) {#anyatva#} ‘difference’ or ‘distinction’; {#apawaH#} not a cloth,
 something different from, or other than, a cloth.
∙³({%d%}) {#alpatA#} ‘smallness’, ‘diminution’, used as a diminutive particle;
 {#anudarA#} having a slender waist ({#kfSodarI#} or {#tanumaDyamA#}).
∙³({%e%}) {#aprASastya#} ‘badness’, ‘unfitness’, having a depreciative
 sense; {#akAlaH#} wrong or improper time; {#akAryam#} not fit to be done,
 improper, unworthy, bad act.
∙³({%f%}) {#viroDa#} ‘opposition’, ‘contrariety’; {#anItiH#} the opposite
 of morality, immorality; {#asita#} not white, black; {#asura#} not a god,
 a demon <ab>&c.</ab> These senses are put together in the following verse:− {#tatsAdfSyamaBAvaSca#}
 {#tadanyatvaM tadalpatA . aprASastyaM viroDaSca naYarTAH zaw prakIrtitAH ..#}
 See {#na#} also. With verbal derivatives, such as gerunds, infinitives,
 participles, it has usually the sense of ‘not’; {#adagDvA#} not having
 burnt; {#apaSyan#} not seeing; so {#asakft#} not once; {#amfzA, akasmAt#}
 <ab>&c.</ab> Sometimes in {#bahuvrIhi a#} does not affect the sense of the second
 member; {#a-paScima#} that which has no last, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} best, topmost;
 {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} {#vipaScitAmapaScimaH#} <ab>cf.</ab> also <ls>R. 19. 1</ls>. {#anuttama#} having
 no superior, unsurpassed, most excellent: (for examples see these words).
∙²2 An interjection of
∙³({%a%}) Pity (ah!) {#a avadyaM#} <ls>P. I. 1. 14. Sk.</ls>
∙³({%b%}) Reproach, censure (fie, shame); {#apacasi tvaM jAlma#} <ls>P. VI. 3. 73. Vārt.</ls>
[Page0001-2]
 See {#akaraRi, ajIvani#} also.
∙³({%c%}) Used in addressing; {#a ananta#}.
∙³({%d%}) It is also used as a particle of prohibition.
∙²3 The augment prefixed to the root in the formation of the Imperfect,
 Aorist and Conditional Tenses. {%<ab>N. B.</ab>%}:− The application of this privative
 prefix is practically unlimited; to give every possible case would almost
 amount to a dictionary itself. No attempt will, therefore, be made to
 give {%every possible%} combination of this prefix with a following word;
 only such words as require a special explanation, or such as most frequently
 occur in literature and enter into compounds with other words, will be
 given; others will be found self-explaining when the <lang>English</lang> ‘in’, ‘un’,
 or ‘not’, is substituted for {#a#} or {#an#} before the meaning of the
 second word, or the sense may be expressed by ‘less’, ‘free from’, ‘devoid or destitute of’
 <ab>&c.</ab>; {#akaTya#} unspeakable; {#adarpa#} without pride,
 or freedom from pride; {#apragalBa#} not bold; {#aBaga#} unfortunate;
 {#avitta#} destitute of wealth <ab>&c.</ab> In many cases such compounds will be
 found explained under the second member. Most compounds beginning with
 {#a#} or {#an#} are either Tatpuruṣa or Bahuvrīhi (to be determined
 by the sense) and should be so dissolved.
<LEND>

<L>2<pc>0001-2<k1>afRin<k2>afRin<e>1
{#afRin#}¦ {%<lex>a.</lex>%} (<ab>epic.</ab>) ({#f#} being here regarded as a consonant) Not

<L>4<pc>0001-2<k1>aMSaH<k2>aMSaH<e>1
{#aMSaH#}¦ [{#aMS-ac#}]
∙²1 A share, part, portion, division; member; {#sakfdaMSo nipatati#} <ls>Ms. 9. 47</ls>;
 {#turyAMSaH#} a fourth part; {#zazWa˚#}; {#mamEvAMSo jIvaloke jIvaBUtaH#}
 {#sanAtanaH#} <ls>Bg. 15. 7</ls>; {#BuvamaMSAviva DarmayorgatO#} <ls>R. 8. 16</ls>; {#aMSena#}
 {#darSitAnukUlatA#} <ls>K. 159</ls> partly.
∙²2 A share in property, inheritance; {#svatoM'SataH#} <ls>Ms. 8. 408</ls>; {#anaMSO#}
 {#klIbapatitO#} <ls n="Ms.">9. 201</ls>; {#patnyaH kAryAH samAMSikAH#} <ls>Y. 2. 115</ls>.
∙²3 the numerator of a fraction; {#anyonyahArABihatO harAMSO#} <ls>Līlā.</ls>;
 sometimes used for fraction itself.
∙²4 A degree of latitude (or longitude); {#akzasyAMSAH samAKyAtAH zazwyuttaraSatatrayam#};
 {#sa ca aMSaH zazwikalAtmakaH, kalA tu zazwivikalAtmikA#}.
∙²5 The shoulder (more correctly written as {#aMsa#}, <ab>q. v.</ab>).
∙²6 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the Ādityas; <ls>Mb. 1. 227. 25</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> also the beginning of
 <ls>T. Ār.</ls> The senses of ‘party’, ‘a share of booty’, ‘earnest money’, which
 are said to occur in the Veda are traceable to 1 above.
∙²7 The vital note in a Rāga.
.━{@<ab>Comp.</ab>@}: {#aMSAMSaH, aMSAMSi, aMSAvatAraH, aMSAvataraRam, aMSakuRqalI, aMSaBAj, aMSahara, aMSahArin, aMSavivartin, aMSasavarRanam, aMSasvaraH#}

<L>4.024<pc>0001-2<k1>aMSAvatAraH<k2>aMSAvatAraH<e>2
